note: Where PEDON's files live. Three places: the APP (this checkout: code, tools, skills, schema — no assets); the LIBRARY (the user's assets, shared by every project: plant and object models, the leaves' textures, reference photos, the plant catalogue — `library_dir`, moved by the env var in `library_env`); and PROJECTS (one per site: its scan, ground truth, designs — `projects_dir`, moved by `projects_env`). `data/...` is a VIRTUAL folder: the names in `library` are the library's, every other name — site.json, design.json, designs/, history/, views/, captures/, review/ ... — belongs to the ACTIVE project (the env var in `env`, else the slug in `active_file`). A path under one of `library_roots` (`assets/...`) is the library's too, so a model a design names is found wherever the library is. The library's own PLANT CODE — a builder per species, made along the way like its models — is in `species_dir`, asked in the order its `order.json` gives (viewer/src/species.js). A folder under projects_dir is a site when it holds one of `project_markers`. Read by tools/project.py and viewer/project_paths.js: one rule, two languages.
